Aspen Adsorption Simulator was used to fit the experimentally measured breakthrough curves and extract equilibrium and kinetic data of the optimized sorbent. Our results indicated that for a DAC plant with CO productivity of 2 3,000 tonne/year, the levelized cost of CO capture was $612/tonne. A sensitivity study was also 2 conducted, revealing a capture cost range of $520-870/tonne. The next phase would be a bench-scale development including the following: ▪ Sorbent material scaleup ▪ Structured sorbent scaleup ▪ Design and construction of the test unit with integrated components ▪ Sorbent mat configuration optimization for process scaleup ▪ Demonstrate DAC performance by integrated testing for 3-6 months ▪ Perform TEA and sensitivity studies and determine operating conditions for low-cost DAC 48 References 1.
